### ble_gatt_lifecycle

平台：android、macOS、windows。

前置条件：可连接、读取并通知的真实 GATT 外设；扫描已确认停止。

操作：连接、发现服务、读取、订阅通知；断开；重新连接后再离开页面。

预期：真实读取和通知对应外设值；断开后无迟到数据回填；重连正常；页面退出后释放连接与订阅。

证据：外设型号与服务/特征值；读回值、通知记录和连接日志。

行为测试来源（待审阅补充模块专属视觉预期）：

- cancelling permission preparation leaves existing system connections alone（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- connection preflight rejects a powered-off adapter（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- permission refusal before connection does not disconnect an unowned device（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- a timed-out native scan start cannot later leave the scanner running（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- scan duration controls the deadline and rejects unbounded requests（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- connection timeout is bounded and a late success is released（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- duplicate characteristic reads share a guarded operation（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- scan preserves previous results and ages advertisement state（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- stopping keeps scan active until backend confirmation（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- unconfirmed scan stop blocks connection and supports another stop（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- connection phases separate the native link from GATT readiness（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- cancel releases a connecting device and cleans a late successful connection（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- a late service discovery cannot refill a cancelled connection（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- unexpected disconnect invalidates in-flight service discovery（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- disconnect keeps the link visible until the native state is confirmed（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- a silent disconnect failure remains unconfirmed and can be retried（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- failed connection can retry the same selected target（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- a late read cannot refill values after disconnect（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- page disposal cannot receive a late discovery update（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- leaving the foreground requests a confirmed scan stop（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- connection progress exposes cancellation and retry controls（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- RSSI updates preserve row order and show last-seen state（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_controls_test.dart`）
- $platform shows a two-pane workspace and settings entry（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_session_test.dart`）
- compact Android supports large text and long device names（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_session_test.dart`）
- Windows uses the common BLE page without Android system controls（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_session_test.dart`）
- system audio and GATT connections appear at top without scan（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_session_test.dart`）
- Android powered-on control opens settings for shutdown（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_session_test.dart`）
- connection refresh replaces stale system devices and preserves active GATT（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_session_test.dart`）
- Bluetooth power-off clears current system and application connections（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_session_test.dart`）
- connected device stays at top with disconnect action（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_session_test.dart`）
- Android can request the system Bluetooth switch（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_session_test.dart`）
- scan list favors readable names and can reveal unnamed devices（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_session_test.dart`）
- catalog opens BLE on Android macOS and Windows without claiming host acceptance（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_session_test.dart`）
- scan stops on timeout and reports empty result（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_session_test.dart`）
- permission refusal prevents scanning（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_session_test.dart`）
- read and subscription obey characteristic properties and release（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/bluetooth_ble/ble_session_test.dart`）

## 文件选择器（file_picker）

路径：`/file-picker`；逻辑测试：`flutter test test/modules/platform/file_picker`（在 apps/flutter_forge 执行）。

### entry_navigation

平台：android、iOS、macOS、web、windows。

前置条件：使用本次构建的应用；记录平台、设备、窗口尺寸及文字缩放。

操作：从目录进入「文件选择器」，再通过稳定路径 /file-picker 进入；返回目录并再次进入。

预期：开放平台进入教学页面；关闭平台展示统一不可用说明。返回与重进正确，无残留弹窗或错误页面。

证据：目录、页面或不可用说明截图；操作记录。

### layout_and_readability

平台：android、macOS、web、windows。

前置条件：移动或紧凑窗口使用 360dp；桌面另测宽窗口；使用系统大字体。

操作：进入页面，滚动到末尾；展开页面已有说明、菜单或弹窗；调整窗口宽度后重复。

预期：文字与关键控件可读可操作；无溢出、遮挡或截断；滚动及关闭弹窗正常。

证据：紧凑、大字体与宽窗口截图；异常时附尺寸与复现步骤。

### file_provider_pick_cancel

平台：android、macOS、web、windows。

前置条件：真实系统文件提供器或浏览器；准备模块能消费的合法样本；允许文件访问。

操作：触发文件选择；选择合法样本并观察结果；重新打开选择器后取消；返回页面后再次选择。

预期：结果符合页面实际用途；取消不误报选择成功，不崩溃且页面可再次操作；Web 不承诺本地绝对路径。

证据：系统选择器与结果截图；取消后的状态与再次选择记录。

行为测试来源（待审阅补充模块专属视觉预期）：

- catalog admits file picker on Android, macOS, and Windows（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/file_picker/file_picker_test.dart`）
- picked file shows its name and path（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/file_picker/file_picker_test.dart`）
- cancelled selection renders the cancel branch（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/file_picker/file_picker_test.dart`）
- missing plugin renders platform unsupported state（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/file_picker/file_picker_test.dart`）
- filter mode controls allowed extensions（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/file_picker/file_picker_test.dart`）
- file picker fits a compact Android viewport（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/file_picker/file_picker_test.dart`）

行为测试来源（待审阅补充模块专属视觉预期）：

- catalog admits online video on Android, macOS, and Windows（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/online_video_player/online_video_player_test.dart`）
- controls render playback, seek, rate and volume controls（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/online_video_player/online_video_player_test.dart`）
- play pause button follows adapter state（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/online_video_player/online_video_player_test.dart`）
- module shows error placeholder without network access（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/online_video_player/online_video_player_test.dart`）
- video controls fit a compact Android viewport（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/online_video_player/online_video_player_test.dart`）
- probe failure reaches error without creating any controller（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/online_video_player/video_player_adapter_test.dart`）
- platform policy can let the player initialize without a probe（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/online_video_player/video_player_adapter_test.dart`）
- default probe uses a ranged GET compatible with media servers（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/online_video_player/video_player_adapter_test.dart`）
- default probe rejects an unreadable response stream（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/online_video_player/video_player_adapter_test.dart`）
- no-frame monitor disposes the controller and enters error state（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/online_video_player/video_player_adapter_test.dart`）
- global loading watchdog releases a stalled initialization（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/online_video_player/video_player_adapter_test.dart`）
- Windows uses the shorter default initialize timeout（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/online_video_player/video_player_adapter_test.dart`）
- initialize failure releases the previous controller and errors（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/online_video_player/video_player_adapter_test.dart`）
- initialize timeout can be rebuilt on the next open（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/online_video_player/video_player_adapter_test.dart`）
- dispose releases a live controller without hanging（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/online_video_player/video_player_adapter_test.dart`）
- concurrent open discards the superseded generation（`apps/flutter_forge/test/modules/platform/online_video_player/video_player_adapter_test.dart`）
